_comment: Token-optimized OpenClaw runtime settings. Copy to ~/.openclaw/settings.json

limits._comment: Adjust monthly_usd to match your budget. OpenClaw will warn you when approaching the limit.

_notes.model: Use claude-sonnet-4-5 as the default. Only invoke claude-opus-4-5 explicitly for complex orchestration tasks.
_notes.CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: Sub-agents performing file reads, searches, and simple edits use Haiku by default. Override per-agent in agents/<id>/agent/config.json if needed.
_notes.MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: Reduced from the 32k default to 10k. Handles ~90% of tasks. Raise to 20000-32000 only for large-scale refactoring or architectural design sessions.
_notes.CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE: Trigger auto-compaction at 50% of context window instead of 95%. Keeps context lean and prevents runaway token accumulation. Use /compact manually at phase boundaries.
_notes.OLLAMA_BASE_URL: Points to the local Ollama API server. Change the port if you have reconfigured Ollama.
